scheme_name: Supply of Sarees and Dhoties to Differently Abled Persons
other_conditions: Resident of the Union Territory of Puducherry for at least 5 years
Registered name in the local anganwadi centre
Recipient of financial assistance from the Directorate of Social Welfare, Government of Puducherry
benefits_summary: Free dhotis and sarees or equivalent direct benefit transfer during Diwali, Pongal and local festivals.
documents_required: Copies of mandatory documents (self‑attested if required)
